class.jaymoskingdoms.option.green_return: Look at a fresh body that still has its head, within three minutes of its death. It gets up alive, as who it was, weak and at under half its health. Not a player's body, and not a headless one.
message.jaymoskingdoms.thorn.nothing: Nothing for it to do here.
message.jaymoskingdoms.green_return.drui: Only a Druid can say this rite.
message.jaymoskingdoms.green_return.none: There is no fresh body here to call back.
message.jaymoskingdoms.green_return.head: It has no head. Nothing can be called back into it.
